limitations: Only 50% hard-edge Wipe1/Feather0 half-plane geometry. Arbitrary completion, feather, animated center, guide deformation, and nonidentity source clocks remain unsupported.
Imported FX uses existing PathMask geometry, not a dedicated Radial Wipe control. Export recognizes geometry regardless of IDs/names and does not recover discarded source metadata.

Only explicit edited Hold case has independent export render/alpha equality. Linear keys, source-origin rebasing and effect order have structural tests, not additional independent Adobe fidelity claims.
The last native key has no outgoing Hold flag because no following interval exists; independent sample values match through end of composition.
Public MP4 references are long_term Assets, never Git files. Licensed Intro evidence stays local. This does not establish full-project bidirectional fidelity.
